Curry leaves may help reduce oxidative stress and support cholesterol regulation, but they are not powerful enough to prevent heart attacks on their own.

The Calgary Board of Education (CBE) stated that these accommodations did not change the school's normal lunch areas and did not bar students from eating on campus.

The £2.6 billion figure refers to a projected overspend for the 2025/26 year, rather than a budget cut.
The £2.6 billion figure originated from a leaked MoD internal spending estimate reported by the Telegraph in October 2025.
The Ministry of Defence's budget for 2025/26 is £62.2 billion, which is an increase of approximately 3.2% in cash terms compared to 2024/25.
The MoD's budget is projected to increase by an average of 3.8% a year in real terms between 2025/26 and 2028/29.

The claim that Trump ended eight wars is false because many of the listed conflicts remain unresolved and his role as a peace broker is disputed.
India has repeatedly rejected Trump's claim of ending the war against Pakistan.
Serbia and Kosovo were not in an open state of war, and they have never signed a final peace treaty.
Egypt and Ethiopia were never at war during Trump's presidency, and the dispute over the Grand Renaissance Dam continues.
Fighting in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda continued even after a peace deal was signed in June 2025.
The conflict in Gaza is still ongoing despite a ceasefire document signed by Trump in October 2025.

Hair fall is influenced by complex factors including genetics, hormonal changes, nutritional deficiencies, and underlying medical conditions.

Dr. Rema Devi T J, a dermatologist, states that rubbing mango seed is not a proven scientific method for hair fall, though mango seed oil or butter might be beneficial for hair health due to fatty acids and vitamins.
The World Health Organisation (WHO) has classified both sunbeds and smoking as Group 1 cancer-causing hazards.
Smoking increases the risk of lung cancer by an estimated 1,400% to 2,900%.
Smoking is linked to a much wider variety of cancers and non-cancer health risks than sunbed use.
Cancer Research UK states that while both are Group 1 carcinogens, tobacco has a much bigger impact on cancer cases.
Vladislav Heraskevych's helmet is a memorial object featuring portraits of 22 Ukrainian athletes who died during the Russian-Ukrainian war.
The helmet does not contain terrorist symbols, calls for violence, political slogans, or military symbols like unit chevrons.
The portraits on the helmet include athletes who died in missile attacks or during the full-scale invasion, as well as those who died defending their country.
Vladislav Heraskevych was disqualified from the 2026 Winter Olympics after refusing to follow the IOC's suggestion to wear a black ribbon instead of the memorial helmet.

The claim that AI chatbots prove the existence of 'chemtrails' is based on social media posts that misinterpret or manipulate AI responses.
AFP was unable to replicate the conspiratorial ChatGPT responses using the prompts shared in the viral posts.
Experts warn that AI chatbots can 'hallucinate' information, use unreliable sources, or be manipulated by specific prompts to bypass safety guardrails.
Large Language Models (LLMs) can present claims with high confidence even when they are incorrect or lack proper verification.
The claim that a drink made of shakkar, sesame seeds, and sonth can regularize menstrual periods in 21 days is false and not supported by scientific or clinical evidence.

Menstrual irregularities are typically caused by underlying hormonal imbalances, medical conditions, or lifestyle factors, rather than something that can be corrected by home remedies in a fixed timeframe.
While sesame seeds contain nutrients like lignans that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, research suggests any potential impact on hormones would require weeks or months, not 21 days.

Sesame seeds, sonth (dry ginger), and shakkar (jaggery) have nutritional benefits, such as anti-inflammatory properties and mineral content, but they are not substitutes for medical treatment for irregular periods.
Soleus Push-Ups and regular physical activity can help manage blood sugar levels over time, but they are not a quick fix for immediate reduction.

The SAVE America Act does not require all currently registered voters to re-register to vote.
The bill requires individuals seeking to register to vote in federal elections to present documentary proof of U.S. citizenship in person to an election official.
The bill requires documentary proof of citizenship such as a passport or birth certificate.
Most state driver's licenses and REAL IDs do not contain the citizenship information required by the bill.

Certain groups, such as people who move (even within a state), change their party registration, or change their name, would likely need to update their registration and thus comply with the new requirements.
Any registration update would require the voter to comply with the bill's proof of citizenship requirement.
There is no scientific evidence or medical consensus to support the claim that consuming a drink made with ghee, turmeric, and black pepper can prevent or cure PCOD.
While turmeric may have anti-inflammatory properties and black pepper may aid absorption, they cannot address the underlying hormonal issues of PCOD.
PCOD is a complex hormonal and metabolic condition that cannot be reversed through a single home remedy.
Manfred Weber's proposal for a mandatory service was specifically directed at German youth, not Hungarian youth.
Skin pigmentation develops due to excess melanin production and is a gradual process that cannot disappear within two or three days, especially through home remedies.
While turmeric contains curcumin which has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, neither turmeric nor nutmeg can produce rapid skin-lightening or pigmentation reversal.
Applying raw kitchen ingredients like nutmeg and turmeric directly to the skin may cause irritation, allergic reactions, or contact dermatitis, which can actually worsen pigmentation.
Medical treatments for pigmentation, such as topical depigmenting agents or laser therapy, typically take weeks to months to show visible improvement.
Pigmentation conditions like melasma or post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation typically take weeks to months to improve, even with medical treatment.
The viral photo does not show the USS Abraham Lincoln; it actually shows repair work on the damaged deck of the USS Forrestal in 1967.
CENTCOM released footage from February 28 and March 1, 2026, which did not show the extensive damage claimed in the viral photo.
A single yoga posture like the butterfly pose is not a shortcut to normal glucose levels, especially for those with insulin resistance, long-standing diabetes, or other medical factors.

Butterfly pose primarily stretches the hips and inner thighs and encourages calm breathing, but it lacks the sustained muscle work required to consistently use up glucose, unlike brisk walking or cycling.
The claim is medically vague because it does not specify whether 'normal blood sugar' refers to fasting levels, post-meal levels, or HbA1c.
Claims that Rupert Lowe demanded Keir Starmer surrender £95 million in profits linked to NHS reform legislation are false.
There is no evidence to support the allegation that Keir Starmer made profits from NHS reform legislation.
The report that eight Ukrainian athletes did not return from the 2026 Milan Olympics is unconfirmed by both Ukraine’s National Olympic Committee and the Youth and Sports Ministry.
The Center for Countering Disinformation identified the claim about athletes fleeing to avoid conscription as a fake news item and part of a Russian information operation.
There is no legal basis or evidence in Ukrainian law that links an athlete's performance (such as winning medals) to military service or conscription.
There is no federal 'Born In America' act currently under consideration in Congress.
A search of the Google News index yielded no real reports regarding a 'Born in America Act'.

Experts dispute the claim that Iran could 'soon' have missiles capable of reaching the United States.
Recent estimates suggest Iran lacks intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) capability and appears to maintain a self-imposed missile range limit of 2,000 km.
A Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) report from May 2025 projected that Iran could develop a militarily-viable ICBM by 2035 if it chose to pursue the capability.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denied that Iran is developing long-range missiles, stating they intentionally limit range to below 2,000 kilometers.
The photos circulating on social media that claim to show Austin Tucker Martin are mislabeled and depict an unidentified person who does not resemble Martin.
California paid the Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights (CHIRLA) approximately $115 million for the 2019-2025 fiscal years.
98% of the funds paid to CHIRLA by the state ($113 million out of $115 million) came from California's Department of Social Services.
State budget records show no evidence that funds were used to pay or organize protesters, nor are there line items for activist stipends or demonstration organizing.

The White House has not responded to inquiries regarding whether an invitation was extended to the Seahawks.
Championship teams typically visit the White House a few months after winning, often in the spring or summer.

The viral claim has been spread through Facebook posts that are part of a network of foreign websites and pages, including some run by people in Vietnam.

A Thai immigration official stated that there has been no mass arrival of hundreds of thousands of Israelis in Thailand.
The figure of 425,000 is approximately the number of Israeli visitors to Thailand in the year 2025.
As of the end of March 2026, officials estimate that approximately 30,000 Israeli nationals were in Thailand.
Between January 1 and March 11, officials recorded 84,238 arrivals and 80,171 departures from Israel, indicating no unusual accumulation of visitors.

Deliberate Russian attacks have led to complete external power loss at Ukrainian nuclear facilities at least 13 times as of September 2025.
